items.title: CoreWeave surges, but bigger tests loom for the AI trade

The rally offers a much-needed boost to AI investors, but bigger tests lie ahead, with Nvidia (NVDA) earnings next week and Anthropic (ANTH.PVT) preparing for a potential IPO. Host Kevin Kelly, Kelly Intelligence Founder, CEO, and CCO, and his panel of experts weigh in.Today's panel includes EP Wealth Advisors Managing Director of Investments Adam Phillips, Zacks Investment Management Chief Market Strategist Brian Mulberry, and ProShares Global Investment Strategist Simeon Hyman.
